events.title: Hong Kong court sentences Tiananmen vigil activists to between 5 and 7 years in jail

Prosecutors had argued that China's constitution enshrines the primacy of the Communist Party.

events.title: Manchester United thrash Sabah in Champions League return as Fabregas's Como shine in European debut
events.description: Manchester United marked their Champions League return with a 4-0 rout of Sabah on Thursday, with Matheus Cunha, Bruno Fernandes, Benjamin Sesko and Lisandro Martinez scoring. Bayern Munich thrashed Bodo/Glimt 5-0 as Ballon d'Or nominees Michael Olise struck twice and Harry Kane scored, while Cesc Fabregas's Como impressed on their competition debut.

events.title: Iceland set to open store in Falklands and become first UK high street retailer on islands
events.description: Iceland has confirmed it will open a store on the Falkland Islands, becoming the first UK high street brand to operate there.

events.title: Royal row engulfs Ugandan kingdom after late king's family rejects TV anchor successor
events.description: A bitter royal row has broken out in a Ugandan kingdom after the late king's family rejected the choice of a news anchor to succeed him.

events.title: What to know about Sunday's election in Sweden, NATO's newest member
events.description: Sweden is holding an election Sunday that will determine whether a conservative leader remains in charge and a hard-right party wins ministerial jobs for the first time, or whether the center-left returns to power

events.title: Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing visits Cambodia as he seeks to restore ASEAN engagement
events.description: Myanmar’s military-backed president is in Cambodia to meet its leaders

events.title: Carney calls Trump’s latest trade measures ‘relatively modest,’ signals restraint
events.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney signaled that Canada may hold off on further retaliation against President Donald Trump’s latest trade measures, calling them “relatively modest” compared to earlier U.S. actions

events.title: British man charged with aiding Russian spies to sabotage UK drone factory
events.description: Prosecutors in London say a British man plotted with Russian spies to sabotage a drone factory in England

events.title: China says it hopes to agree with US on tariff reductions 'at an early date'
events.description: A Chinese government spokesperson says China and the U.S. hope to reach an agreement on lowering import taxes soon

events.title: Ebola response in eastern DR Congo must include food assistance, WFP says
events.description: As Ebola sweeps across the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), ensuring families meet their basic food needs is crucial to halt the spread of the deadly disease.

events.title: Syria’s transition hinges on justice for all, UN Human Rights Council hears
events.description: A successful and lasting transition in Syria requires comprehensive accountability, inclusion and guarantees that violations will not be repeated, UN independent investigators told the Human Rights Council in Geneva on Tuesday.

events.title: Charlie Kirk supporters return to site of assassination 1 year later: ‘We are still standing’
events.description: Turning Point USA returned to Utah Valley University to reclaim the space where Charlie Kirk was assassinated, unveiling a new statue in his honor.

events.title: Juror on Lindsay Clancy trial says 'we let down Lindsay' following mistrial
events.description: A Lindsay Clancy trial juror says the jury "let down Lindsay" after a lone holdout prevented a unanimous not guilty verdict in Massachusetts.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer torches conspiracy theories accusing Patrick Clancy
events.description: Lindsay Clancy's attorney defended Patrick Clancy, rejecting conspiracy theories and arguing evidence cited by prosecutors does not prove the killings were premeditated.

events.title: Family of 9/11 hero to retrace his steps in final Tunnel to Towers stop
events.description: Frank Siller and family will retrace Stephen Siller's iconic run through the Brooklyn-Battery Tunnel to the Twin Towers on the 25th anniversary.

events.title: Days after Lindsay Clancy mistrial, another Massachusetts mom accused of killing her children seeks freedom
events.description: Janette MacAusland's defense sought dismissal after prosecutors said they are still waiting on the medical examiner's findings in the Wellesley murder case.

events.title: FBI arrests suspect accused of paying LA homeless to forge signatures using registered voters' identities
events.description: James Brass allegedly ran a ballot harvesting scheme on Los Angeles' Skid Row, paying homeless people to sign petitions using stolen voter identities.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy's attorney asks judge to acquit her outright, ending case and barring a retrial
events.description: A fellow juror reveals the lone holdout in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial used an exercise band and water bottle to reenact the strangulation.

events.title: Salvation Army responder opens up on 9/11 cancer battle, phone call that changed his life
events.description: Salvation Army responder Ken Tregellas battled stage 4 cancer after months at Ground Zero but says he wouldn't have changed a thing about serving.

events.title: Hiker in Georgia makes disturbing discovery on mountain
events.description: White County Sheriff Rick Kelley says more details are forthcoming after the remains of two people were found on Mount Yonah, a popular northeast Georgia hiking spot.

events.title: Philippines defense chief calls out China after note interrupts remarks at Seoul forum: 'Coercion, bullying'
events.description: Gilberto Teodoro read aloud a note from China handed to him mid-speech at the Seoul Defense Dialogue, calling it actual coercion and bullying.

events.title: Art heist thieves make off with Renoir paintings worth millions from museum on French Riviera
events.description: Two thieves cut through a fence at the French Riviera's Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer, stealing four paintings but dropping two as police closed in.

events.title: UN agency accused of Hamas ties sees another European nation cut funding
events.description: Finland will discontinue UNRWA funding by end of 2026, following the Trump administration and Sweden in cutting ties with the Hamas-linked U.N. agency.
